title: Check User Exists
description: Check whether a Linux user account exists.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

USER_NAME="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$USER_NAME" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 username" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if id "$USER_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    id "$USER_NAME"
    echo "User exists: $USER_NAME"
else
    echo "User does not exist: $USER_NAME"
    exit 1
fi
